# Cully v0.8.2

Cully MCP totals now include every observed Cully tool call from the foreground coding agent, its linked advisor and startup checks. Separate Foreground, Advisor and Startup counts explain the combined total. Other MCP servers stay outside these counters, and advisor/startup calls do not change foreground coding activity.

Open the advisor with Ctrl+] / F6 and press Tab for a scrollable breakdown of every Cully tool, including recent, projects, update and delete. Counts and source totals persist under the same hashed coding-thread identity and continue across resume. Semantic recall includes direct recall and semantic context calls, while the actual tool-name counts remain distinct.

Upgrades preserve previously saved category totals. Earlier grouped Other counts retain an explicit earlier_other label because their tool names were not saved; previously excluded background calls cannot be reconstructed. Counts record actual hook events rather than worker claims or mentions in orchestration code. Telemetry stores no arguments, responses, credentials or retrieved memory.

Validation covers every tool/source, future tool names, malformed-name rejection, concurrent hooks, upgrade preservation, resumed totals, worker scope isolation, privacy, compact two-comment visibility and scrollable details, with formatting, vet and the full race suite.
